articles.title: Alok Infotech Wins Prestigious PMFME Scheme Digital Promotions Tender
articles.description: Chennai (Tamil Nadu) [India], November 2: Alok Infotech, a leading digital marketing agency, today announced that it has won the prestigious tender for Digital Promotions of the PMFME (Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises) Scheme, a flagship initiative by the Central Government.

articles.title: What GeM Did for Government Buying, Shrevit Wants to Do for Private Enterprise Procurement
articles.description: Mumbai (Maharashtra) [India], November 2: When the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) moved public purchasing in India onto a single digital platform, it gave government buyers something most private companies still lack: one transparent, rule-bound environment where every tender, bid and approval leaves a record. Inside many enterprises, procurement still runs on long email threads, spreadsheets saved as "Quote_v3_FINAL", missing vendor documents and approvals that sit unattended for days.
